_meta.title: Celebrity marriage month benchmark
_meta.purpose: Exploratory retrospective test of KP marriage month timing
_meta.source_policy: Each record was individually inspected; no scraping or bulk harvesting.
_meta.limitations: Small convenience sample, one event class. Cannot prove scientific validity. Do not tune the model on these same cases.
_meta.method: Hit if the actual marriage month is in Moon-triggered candidates during a qualifying Dasa-Bhukti-Anthara. Sun, Jupiter and DBA-lord transits through the same zone/month are recorded as corroboration, not required gates.
